summary: Houses stand in a circle, so the first house and the last house are neighbors. Each house holds a non-negative integer amount of cash. On the same night you must not enter two houses that touch, or an alarm rings. Read the cash in every house and write the largest total you can carry while the alarm stays silent. Any number of houses may be skipped. Skipping every house yields a total of 0.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
